facts.text: Serve the quesadillas when Gale talks her way onto the Stab 3 set at Sunrise Studios.
facts.why: Gale does not talk her way on. She is thrown off the closed set, and Wikipedia has her find Dewey working there as an adviser.
facts.fix: Serve the quesadillas when Gale finds Dewey advising on the Stab 3 set at Sunrise Studios.

facts.why: The transcript says Stab 3 is a closed set, but no stage number is given.

vibe.verdict: A craft services truck on the Stab 3 set with Dewey's note, but the cue and the tape, voice and reveal winks don't print and the menu is a plain list.
